name: pg_bolt
abstract: GPU-accelerated analytical SQL extension powered by craton-bolt
description: pg_bolt caches PostgreSQL relations as Apache Arrow RecordBatch snapshots in NVIDIA GPU VRAM, analyzes incoming SQL queries for GPU or Hybrid execution eligibility, and exposes both bolt.* SQL entry points and a PostgreSQL CustomScan planner hook.
